lastResponse.text: Yes, I hear you. This sounds urgent and your safety comes first. If those men are circling and you feel in danger, call nine one one now. If you can, move toward a lit public spot with other people nearby while you call. I can get you to a live two one one person next, but please call nine one one first if there’s immediate danger.
originalTexts: Yes, I hear you. This sounds urgent and your safety comes first. If those men are circling and you feel in danger, call **911 now**. If you can, move toward a lit public spot with other people nearby while you call. I can get you to a live 211 person next, but please call 911 first if there’s immediate danger.
